title: Refund & Money-Back Policy
text: Money-back policy for customer purchases. Sales representatives may approve a refund of up to $50 per invoice without manager sign-off. Refunds above $50 require written approval from a regional sales manager. All refund requests must be filed within 30 days of the invoice date. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method.

title: Discount Approval Matrix
text: Sales representatives may offer discounts of up to 10% on list price. Discounts between 10% and 20% need manager approval. Anything above 20% requires VP approval.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
text: Employees can be refunded up to $500 for pre-approved travel expenses. Receipts must be submitted within 14 days of the trip. Alcohol is never reimbursable.

title: Parental Leave Policy
text: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Leave may be taken in one block or split into two blocks within the first year.

title: Salary Bands (Confidential)
text: Level 3 engineers are paid between 95,000 and 120,000 per year. Level 4 engineers are paid between 120,000 and 150,000 per year.

title: Company Holidays 2026
text: The office is closed on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and December 25. Employees also receive one floating holiday.
